description:
An operator runs a defined scenario from the recorded promoted generation, with independent source, guest state, and results for each attempt.

## Scope

* In: snapshot-lane construction and candidate convergence, source-generation recording, declared additional Nodes, failure handling, and scenario command guidance.
* Out: cold-constructor changes, parallel scheduling, new product behavior, shared-checkpoint creation, feature-proof gates, and snapshot promotion.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A selected snapshot scenario records and clones one promoted generation, synchronizes the exact candidate, and converges it before any exercise action; a missing or unverifiable generation prevents exercise and produces an infrastructure-error result. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/SnapshotScenarioRunnerTest.php` and Incus harness acceptance `snapshot-scenario-lifecycle`.
- [ ] Repeating the same scenario starts from a fresh isolated clone and cannot observe a previous run's application or filesystem mutations. Proof: Incus harness acceptance `snapshot-scenario-isolation`.
- [ ] A declared extra Node has its own recorded base fingerprint, physical identity, capacity reservation, and exact cleanup; an undeclared or existing foreign resource cannot be adopted. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/SnapshotScenarioRunnerTest.php` and Incus harness acceptance `snapshot-scenario-extension`.
- [ ] Failed preparation skips the flow's exercise, records diagnostics and cleanup, and does not stop another independent selected flow; results use the same complete aggregate contract as cold scenarios. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Feature/Commands/ScenarioWrapperTest.php`.
- [ ] Successful and failed runs leave the promoted generation, its VMs, manifest, and other attempts unchanged; no scenario output is accepted as feature proof or promotion evidence. Proof: Incus harness acceptance `snapshot-scenario-isolation`.
- [ ] Maintained scenario guidance describes snapshot inputs and failure behavior, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Harness checks pass. Proof: `cd apps/e2e && composer check`.
title: Run scenarios from an isolated promoted snapshot
